productTitle: Unisex Wide Toe Box Lace Up Outdoor Casual Shoes Synthetic Leather Upper Black Beige Green Pink Wholesale EU 36-48
textDesc:
Wide toe box style: A rounded forefoot gives this lace-up shoe a broad front profile for casual outdoor assortments.
Synthetic leather upper: Stitched side panels contrast with a black toe bumper and dark sole edge across four colourways.
Extended lace-up front: Round laces pass through metal eyelets along the long vamp, with laces matched to each colourway.
Collar and heel details: A fabric collar and vertical rear pull strip finish the low-cut profile.
Four wholesale colourways: Black, Beige and Green cover EU 36–48; Pink covers EU 36–42 for size-mix planning.
